# cf-rollback: roll back with confidence

Rollback is not a panic button, it is a procedure. When a post-deploy
check fails, this skill takes the release back — calmly, safely and
completely. Let me walk you through how it works.

1. Find the previous release tag in the release ledger.
2. Verify the artifact hash of that tag.
3. Run `deploy --to <tag>` in staging.
4. Hand the production command to the operator; the agent never rolls back
   production on its own.
5. Record the rollback in the release ledger with the reason and the
   failing check.

Database migrations are out of scope: use cf-migrate.
